name: Titicaca
cadence_note: every 2th year (plus 2025) to fit the time budget; not interpolated
why_selected: Large, relatively stable lake; control example. Shared by Peru and Bolivia. Data-only description.
mndwi_note: Control lake: level varies by about 1-2 m, which changes area only a little in the deep basin; shallow bays with reeds are uncertain. Southern hemisphere: water year Apr-Mar for climate.

lake_polygon.method: largest connected MNDWI>0 component (pixel water in >=50% of valid years) containing the seed, +1 km buffer

basin.fallback_reason: ValueError: no basin intersects the lake polygon

masks_encoding: PNG uint8: 0 no data, 90 land, 255 water; grid.json has crs/affine/shape
